title: An analytical solution of a quantum system with non-Markovian behavior: The Bixon-Jortner system in time domain
summary: Non-Markovian behavior in quantum systems is often studied in the context of bipartite systems consisting of a system of interest and an environment -- tracing over the environment results in non-Markovian behavior for the subsystem of interest. One may get a Markovian limit in certain regimes, which is studied using the Lindblad master equation, and corrections to this behavior can be obtained by techniques such as the Nakajima-Zwanzig formalism.
